_note: The narrator's text-to-speech model, pinned (founder ruling 2026-11-07, docs/DECISIONS.md). Ported from aacrit/void--news pipeline/briefing/kokoro.lock.json at 775cc33481f72a955e7f6fa6c29b03a17bc7fe39. The files live outside git, under DOCUMENT_KOKORO_DIR (default D:/document-media/models/kokoro); studio/engine/narrator.py checks each file's size and sha256 before any use and refuses a mismatch. Founder ruling 2026-11-07: models and software that make our sound are tools, not source inputs; Apache-2.0 is fine with credit; source inputs keep the current licence allowlist.
license_quote: "license: apache-2.0" (model card front matter, https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, revision f3ff3571791e39611d31c381e3a41a3af07b4987); "With Apache-licensed weights, Kokoro can be deployed anywhere from production environments to personal projects." The voice packs (voices/*.pt, af_aoede among them) are files of the same repository under the same licence; VOICES.md states no other terms for any voice.
training_data_note: The model card lists CC BY audio in Kokoro v1.0's training set (Koniwa tnc, CC BY 3.0; SIWIS, CC BY 4.0). It is training data, not a voice pack or an input to a film.
